# Simple Data Analysis Core v2.1.16

> Lightweight DuckDB-powered TypeScript library for tabular, SQL, CSV, Parquet, and geospatial data analysis on Node.js.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [SDAError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/classes/SDAError.md): SDAError class
- [SimpleDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/classes/SimpleDB.md): SimpleDB class
- [SimpleTable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/classes/SimpleTable.md): SimpleTable class
- [createDirectory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/createDirectory.md): createDirectory function
- [mergeOptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/mergeOptions.md): mergeOptions function
- [parseValue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/parseValue.md): parseValue function
- [queryDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/queryDB.md): queryDB function
- [queueAsyncBarrier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/queueAsyncBarrier.md): queueAsyncBarrier function
- [quoteIdentifier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/quoteIdentifier.md): quoteIdentifier function
- [stringToArray](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/stringToArray.md): stringToArray function
- [updateColumnsWithJS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/v2.1.16/docs/functions/updateColumnsWithJS.md): updateColumnsWithJS function
